title: Treaty of Basel (1499)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Basel (1499)", at revision 1247046986, opens: "The Treaty of Basel of 22 September 1499 was an armistice following the Battle of Dornach, concluding the Swabian War, fought between the Swabian League and the Old Swiss Confederacy." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q685164, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "armistice following the Battle of Dornach". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
